author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs cross-platform daily check-ins using Twitch/Kick rewards and YouTube/TikTok Viewer Foundation points.
changelog: 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with stable-ID daily uniqueness, configurable calendar time zone, monthly rollover, simulator-safe previews, and a bounded hosted leaderboard card.

manifest.name: Village Roll Call
installationSteps: Create Twitch and Kick check-in rewards. Keep both Reward Redemption triggers attached to their platform intakes.
Create the configured no-response check-in command for YouTube and TikTok through Command Sync.
Enable Viewer Foundation, choose the points cost and calendar time zone, then enable Village Roll Call.
Optionally add the hosted browser source to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs and send a preview.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its bounded private leaderboard remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Confirms daily uniqueness, monthly rollover, bounded state, and overlay cards.
